name: Maou
source:
The Demon King who has been reincarnated from another world in which he ruled. He was defeated in battle against a hero and was killed.

He was additionally cursed by the hero. His magical power had been weakened, his iconic demon horns had disappeared, and a cursed stigmata appears on his chest.

Although magical power can be used in this new modern world, it is very weak because magic relies on spirits. Spiritual power is very low in the modern world.

Nevertheless, the Demon King is determined to rule this new reincarnated modern world and his former world. The first step in his conquest begins with the Yawato sisters!
